highlights: Architected GenAI Lab, a Micro Frontend platform in React.js for US enterprise client SHI, where each AI service (RAG, Multimodal, Report Generator) has its own independent frontend and Python backend with ArgoCD-based deployments, currently live in production.

Designed and shipped 20+ REST APIs using FastAPI with response times under 200ms, and wrote unit and integration tests using pytest, unittest, and Jest to keep the codebase stable across releases.
Built a full-stack HRMS in Python and Frappe Framework serving 100+ users, working in a team of 2 and delivering all core modules on time using Git-based version control and Agile workflows.

Worked with AWS S3 for file storage, EC2 and Lambda for compute and event-based processing, and implemented role-based access control using Keycloak with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC across a FastAPI and React.js stack.
